meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: 把任务拆成一条条极小步骤写进实时计划清单,先按参考文档登记目标,要求每项成功标准都有可观测证据,状态存在 .omo/ulw-loop 账本,中断后可续跑。
howto.when: 当你提到 “ulw-loop”、“ulw”,或要求带检查点的长时执行、以证据为主线的工作时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这个任务拆成一步步有证据的执行
say.note: 会先登记目标并建立计划清单

say.text: ulw-loop 断点续跑:先读目标和账本再继续
say.note: 不重新规划,从上次状态接上

say.text: 查一下 ulw-loop 当前状态和下一步动作

howto.what_en: A goal-like loop that splits work into tiny steps, registers goals first, mirrors each step into a live plan checklist, requires observable evidence per criterion, and keeps checkpointed state in .omo/ulw-loop.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention “ulw-loop” or “ulw”, or ask for durable, checkpointed long-running execution or evidence-led work.

say_en.text: Run this task as a ulw-loop: split it into steps with evidence
say_en.note: Registers goals and builds a plan checklist

say_en.text: Resume the ulw-loop: read goals and ledger first, then continue
say_en.note: No re-planning; picks up prior state

say_en.text: Check ulw-loop status and the next actions
